rows.title: Correlation can change when you need it
rows.prompt: Do three earlier observations establish a permanent correlation?
options:
No; the sample and period are limited
Correct answer
rows.feedback:
That’s right.

Correlation is a sample-dependent statistic, not a fixed contract between assets. Three observations supply very little evidence, and a relationship estimated in one period may not hold in another.
